# ProjectProfile

`schemas/config/project-profile.json`

Everything project-shaped (docs/design/m0/07). Core code reads nothing project-specific from anywhere else. Every field is required; null is explicit. Cross-field rules (environment references, path forms, glob syntax, forge capabilities, budget order) belong to internal/profile.

## Definitions

### Argv

A command as argv, run without a shell. Arguments may be empty (some commands need an empty argument); internal/profile requires a non-empty executable and refuses NUL bytes.

Type: array of string (minItems `1`)

### RepoPath

A path inside the repository: relative, slash-separated, clean (internal/profile checks the form).

Type: string (minLength `1`)

### Glob

A repository path pattern: slash-separated segments, each '**' or a path.Match pattern (internal/profile compiles it).

Type: string (minLength `1`)

### Slug

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$`)

### EnvironmentName

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$`)

### PinnedImage

An image reference pinned by digest.

Type: string (pattern `^[^@\t\n\f\r ]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

### USD

An amount in US dollars as a decimal string (no floating point), at most two decimals.

Type: string (pattern `^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$`)
